title: 🔆🔅Tehran, September 16, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman, Responds to the American "Hollywood-Style" Narrative Regarding the Rescue of an Intruding Pilot on Iranian Soil.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran, September 16, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman, Responds to the American "Hollywood-Style" Narrative Regarding the Rescue of an Intruding Pilot on Iranian Soil."

""
"SOT1, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:18): "America, which is accustomed to Hollywood-style narratives—from the beginning of the war until now, if you do a quick search, you will understand how many times the US President has emerged victorious in his own imagination in cyberspace, and how many times he has defeated Iran!""

"SOT2, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi)-(00:19 - 00:34): "Because they are seeking to compensate for their own failures, they may be able to create such scenes by editing together various segments of films from other places.
